component.title: CommandButton
component.purpose: Async commands acknowledge input, preserve layout, and provide recovery.

states.description: The command is ready to run.
The command communicates progress without changing dimensions.
The failed request leaves a clear retry path.
The same control can retry the failed operation.

claims.statement: All command states share one intrinsic label grid so the action does not reflow while work runs.
The action uses a native button with busy, disabled, live-status, keyboard, and focus-visible semantics.
